NVDA.headline: CEO Jensen Huang resigned after disclosing a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy
NVDA.summary: Nvidia opened an investigation on Nov 8 after Huang disclosed an intimate relationship with an executive accused of spying for China; reports of further affairs followed. The board pushed him out and CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO on Nov 12. The Justice Department is reportedly examining possible export-control evasion, and Huang has been summoned to testify before Congress.
